findings.decompiled: mem[ceil32(_data.length) + 292] = _data.length / mem[ceil32(_data.length) + 324 len _data.length] = _data[all] / ... args caller, from, tokenId, 128, mem[ceil32(_data.length) + 292 len ceil32(_data.length) + 32]
findings.issue: The bytes argument is printed as its head offset plus a raw memory slice, although the slice was just written as [length, copy of calldata _data, zero padding]. The 3-argument variant prints its empty bytes as Array(len=0, data='').
findings.rule: A memory region written right before a call as a length word, a copy of n bytes and zero padding to ceil32(n), and placed at the offset given in the head, is an ABI bytes argument: print it as Array(len=n, data=<source of the copy>).

findings.decompiled: mem[0] = tokenId / mem[32] = 2 / ... / mem[0] = from / mem[32] = 3 / balanceOf[from]-- / mem[0] = to / balanceOf[to]++
findings.issue: The mapping-key scratch writes (mem[0], mem[32]) are kept throughout both safeTransferFrom functions. They are dropped in transferFrom, which runs the same transfer code without the onERC721Received call (P8).
findings.rule: A CALL reads only memory[argsOffset, argsOffset + argsSize). A scratch write to words outside that range is dead when the word is overwritten before any other read, even if a call follows.

findings.decompiled: return bool(uint8(stor[10])) / _1 = stor[10] / owner = 0 / log OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner=address(_1 >> 8), ...)
findings.issue: def storage names owner (slot 10, offset 8) but not the bool packed below it, so paused() reads the raw slot. The previous owner in OwnershipTransferred is shown as address(stor[10] >> 8) instead of owner.
findings.rule: Give every field of a packed slot that a getter returns a name in def storage (paused is uint8 at storage 10). Print a read of the whole slot that is only used shifted to a field as a read of that field.

notes: OpenZeppelin 4.9 ERC721 + Enumerable + Burnable + Pausable + Ownable test token. The AST gives source only for mint, counter and supportsInterface, so the inherited functions were checked against OZ 4.9 semantics line by line: approve (two ownerOf checks), burn (_isApprovedOrOwner, owner and all-tokens enumeration removal with both Panic(50) checks and the pop, second ownerOf, deletes, Transfer), _transfer (from/to enumeration arms, re-check, approvals, balances, Transfer), _checkOnERC721Received (isContract, try/catch with empty-reason message and bubbling, bytes4 check), setApprovalForAll, the enumerable getters, tokenURI (empty base URI: return ''), name/symbol storage-string decoding, Ownable. All exact; checks dominated by earlier identical checks are omitted correctly. Pausable is not used by any transfer. The only source loop (mint's for, with counter++ checked by SafeMath.inc and the counter increment unchecked) is a clean while. Round-2 diff (3 lines): tokenURI 'return 32, 0' -> 'return ''', 0x01ffc9a7 now whole bytes, the empty bytes argument now Array(len=0, data=''); all improvements. The two identical bytes4 checks print differently (Mask(32, 224, x) vs x[0 len 4] << 224).
summary: Clean and faithful ERC721 text with its one loop as a while. Minor issues: the bytes argument of onERC721Received is raw memory in the 4-argument safeTransferFrom, dead scratch writes are kept only in the functions that make an external call, and slot 10's paused flag is unnamed.
